Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

work — to do a job. Example: I worked yesterday.
travel — to go from one place to another. Example: Last summer I travelled to Spain.
job — the work you do for money. Example: I have got a good job.
holiday — a day or period of celebration or rest. Example: The holiday is in spring.
decide — to choose after thinking. Example: I am going to decide next year.
plan — an idea about what you will do. Example: What is the plan?
abroad — in or to another country. Example: I am travelling abroad.
career — the work you do over your life. Example: I am going to decide about my career.
free — costing nothing. Example: The museum is free.
choose — to take one thing from several. Example: I am going to choose a new career.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I usually work ...
• This summer I am travelling ...
• I am going to ...
• I would like to travel.
• It is a difficult choice.
